disclaimer.content:
SPA & BEAUTY SERVICES CONTRACT
This Spa & Beauty Services Contract (the "Contract") is entered into between:
(1) The Supplier: HỘ KINH DOANH NEXUS, operating under the brand The Privé Spa or The Privé Spa – International Luxury Nail Care & Spa, with registered address at Số 7 Lê Thị Riêng, Phường Bến Thành, TP Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam (the "Supplier"); and
(2) The Guest: any individual who books, purchases, or receives any services from the Supplier (the "Guest").
The Supplier and the Guest are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties."

Contract Basics & Service Scope
1. Scope, acknowledgement of service, and relationship of the Parties

1.1 Service scope
This Contract governs all spa and beauty services provided by the Supplier, including but not limited to nail services, lash services, waxing, massage, facial and skincare treatments, body treatments, and any related products or add-ons (collectively, the "Services").

1.2 Acknowledgement of service delivery
The Guest expressly acknowledges and agrees that:
a) the Supplier provides the Services as an independent service provider, in accordance with its own professional standards, internal procedures, and applicable regulations; and
b) the Guest actively participates in the provision of the Services, including but not limited to communicating preferences, confirming selections, and cooperating with therapists and staff during the Service procedure.

1.3 No medical services
The Services provided under this Contract are not medical services, do not constitute medical treatment, and are not intended to replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or care.

1.4 Separate engagement per service
Each booking, walk-in visit, or purchase of Services constitutes a separate service engagement governed by this Contract.

 Mode of acceptance

2.1 Publication of Terms and Acceptance by action
These Service Terms and Conditions are publicly made available on the Supplier's website and/or at the Supplier's premises (including but not limited to via QR codes, posted notices, or upon request), in order to allow the Guest to access and review the Terms prior to using the Services.

The Guest confirms their full, unconditional, and irrevocable acceptance of this Contract upon the occurrence of any of the following actions:
• placing a booking request through any channel (including message, phone, website, platform, or in person);
• paying any deposit or settling any amount in connection with the Services;
• providing identification to secure a booking on a voluntary basis for the purposes of booking confirmation, booking security, or reservation holding, and thereby confirming that the Guest has been duly informed, has understood, and consents to the Supplier collecting, storing, and using such information to the extent necessary for the provision of the Services, booking management, and compliance with applicable laws;
• signing, approving, or verbally confirming any service list or pro-forma bill; and/or
• commencing or continuing the Service procedure, including sitting at the service station, allowing preparation, or receiving any part of the Services.

For Guests who book in advance, confirmation of the booking, payment, or continued use of the Services shall be deemed a valid and binding acceptance of this Contract.

For Guests who walk in without a prior booking, the continued use of the Services after being informed of and having a reasonable opportunity to access this Contract shall be deemed a valid and binding acceptance of the Contract.

Acceptance in accordance with this Section shall have the same legal effect as executing the Contract in writing.

2.2 Refusal to accept
If the Guest does not agree to any provision of this Contract, the Guest must not proceed with the booking and must decline the Services before they commence.

How to Book & Confirm Your Appointment
3. Booking process, confirmation, and identity verification

3.1 Booking channels
The Supplier accepts bookings via:
• Meta (Facebook & Instagram)
• Website booking form
• Hotline
• Zalo
• WhatsApp

3.2 Booking confirmation
A booking shall be deemed confirmed only upon written confirmation by the Supplier (including via message or email) or other explicit confirmation of the appointment time and selected Services.

3.3 Deposit and alternative booking security
a) Unless otherwise stated, the Supplier may require a deposit to secure a booking.
b) Deposits are non-refundable, subject to Section 4 (voucher option and cancellation rules).
c) Where the Supplier agrees to proceed without a deposit (including for international transfer convenience), the Guest shall provide a copy of a passport or driver's license for identity verification and booking security. The Guest acknowledges and agrees that failure to provide such identification may result in cancellation or non-confirmation of the booking.

3.4 Late arrival and holding time
If the Guest arrives late, the Supplier may hold the booking for a maximum of fifteen (15) minutes, unless otherwise agreed. After such time, the booking may be treated as a late cancellation or no-show in accordance with Section 4.

3.5. Confirmation of Contract Acceptance in the Booking Process
By confirming a booking, paying a deposit, or proceeding to use the Services, the Guest confirms that he/she has been provided with sufficient information, has read, understood, and voluntarily agreed to the Supplier's Spa & Beauty Services Contract, including but not limited to the terms on booking, changes and cancellations, as well as the terms on liability, waiver, and limitation of liability, and further acknowledges personal responsibility for ensuring that he/she meets the necessary health conditions for the Services to be provided safely.

Changes, Cancellations & No-Shows
4. Changes, cancellations, no-shows, and vouchers

4.1 Booking changes
Any changes to booking time, branch, or Service list should be notified at least two (2) hours prior to the scheduled booking time, unless otherwise agreed by the Supplier.

4.2 Cancellation notice
Cancellations must be notified at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the booking time.

4.3 Voucher in lieu of refund (24-hour rule)
Deposits are non-refundable. Where cancellation notice is provided at least 24 hours in advance, the Guest may request a voucher of equal value to the deposit, subject to the Supplier's verification and voucher issuance policy.

4.4 Late cancellations and no-shows
a) Late cancellations (within 24 hours) and no-shows shall result in forfeiture of any deposit and may additionally result in charges or booking restrictions as notified by the Supplier.
b) Repeated late cancellations or no-shows may result in the Supplier refusing future bookings and limiting the Guest to walk-in services only.

4.5 Supplier cancellation or rescheduling
The Supplier reserves the right to reschedule or cancel bookings due to therapist availability, safety or hygiene concerns, equipment issues, or force majeure events. Where applicable, the Supplier may offer rescheduling, service credit, or another commercially reasonable solution.

Pricing & Payment Terms
5. Pricing policy, transparency, and misunderstanding prevention

5.1 Price confirmation
The Supplier applies a transparent pricing policy. The Guest shall be informed of the total price before the Services commence.

5.2 Binding prices
Once a price is confirmed by the Supplier in writing or via an in-store pro-forma bill, such price shall be deemed final and binding for the relevant booking or session, unless the Guest requests changes or additional Services.

5.3 Reference prices
Prices displayed online or on third-party platforms are provided for reference only. The official applicable prices are those confirmed by the Supplier in writing and/or displayed at the branch at the time of service.

5.4 Pre-service approval
The Services shall commence only after the Guest approves the Service list and pricing, including by signing, verbal confirmation, or proceeding to receive the Services.

5.5 Third-party payment fees
Payments made via QR code, or e-wallet or other non-card shall payment methods are subject to a processing surcharge of five percent (5%), reflecting third-party payment processing costs. This surcharge shall be disclosed to the Guest prior to payment and added to the total payable amount at checkout.

This surcharge shall not apply to card payments or other payment methods that do not incur processing fees, and shall be clearly disclosed to the Guest prior to payment. The Guest's continued election of the foregoing payment methods after such disclosure shall be deemed acceptance of the surcharge, and the surcharge shall be added to the total amount payable at the time of payment.

Your Health & Safety Responsibilities
6. Medical declaration obligation and right of refusal

6.1 Guest's declaration obligation
Prior to receiving any Services, the Guest represents and warrants that, at the time of using the Services, the Guest does not suffer from any medical conditions, health conditions, or personal factors that may directly or indirectly affect the safe provision of the Services, including but not limited to the following:
• medical conditions or circumstances that may cause adverse reactions during the provision of the Services;
• specific health conditions that may increase the risk of complications, irritation, or adverse effects;
• current use of products, medications, or treatment methods that may affect the skin, body, or recovery process;
• any other factors that may render waxing, lash, nail, massage, facial, or body care services unsuitable for or pose potential risks to the Guest.

6.2 No declaration deemed satisfactory condition
Where the Guest does not proactively disclose any health condition that would render the Guest unfit to use the Services, the Guest agrees that the Supplier is entitled to rely on the Guest's representation that the Guest satisfies all necessary conditions to use the Services requested.

6.3 Right to refuse, suspend, or modify
The Supplier reserves the right to refuse, suspend, or modify any Service if, in its professional judgment, proceeding may pose a risk to the Guest's health or safety, or to staff or other guests, based on the Guest's disclosure or on-site observation by the therapist or branch management.

6.4 Medical consultation
Guests are encouraged to consult a qualified medical professional prior to receiving Services if they have any underlying health concerns.

Service Standards & Complaint Handling
7. Handling of issues, dissatisfaction, and complaints

7.1 Immediate reporting requirement
To enable prompt and fair resolution, the Guest must raise any concern, discomfort, dissatisfaction, or suspected issue during the Service or immediately upon completion of the Service, before leaving the premises, or within a reasonable period where the issue becomes apparent only after departure.

7.2 On-site resolution priority
The Guest acknowledges that many issues can only be effectively addressed during or immediately after the Service. Failure to report issues promptly may limit the Supplier's ability to investigate or provide remedies.

7.3 Escalation channels
Guests may escalate concerns via +84 909091140 and/or hotline +84 909095491.

7.4 Aftercare compliance
Where aftercare instructions are provided, the Guest agrees to comply fully. Failure to do so may contribute to adverse outcomes and may affect any goodwill remedies offered by the Supplier.

Guest Conduct & Refusal of Service
8. Guest conduct, safety, and refusal of service

8.1 Compliance obligation
The Guest shall comply with the Supplier's house rules, hygiene standards, and reasonable staff instructions intended to ensure safety and service quality.

8.2 Refusal or termination of Services
The Supplier may refuse or terminate Services where the Guest:
• behaves in a manner that endangers safety or disrupts operations;
• requests inappropriate or unlawful services, including sexual conduct;
• appears under the influence of substances rendering the Service unsafe; and/or
• presents health or hygiene conditions that reasonably prevent safe service delivery.

8.3 Minors (Under 18 Years Old)
Services provided to guests under eighteen (18) years of age shall require the prior consent and presence of a parent or legal guardian throughout the Service. The Supplier reserves the right to refuse, suspend, or terminate any Service where such consent or guardian presence is not provided, or where the Supplier reasonably determines that the Service is not appropriate for a minor.

Liability Waiver & Risk Acknowledgement
9. Liability, waiver, and unforeseeable incidents

9.1 Standard of care
The Supplier shall provide the Services with reasonable professional care in accordance with trained spa and beauty practices and hygiene standards.

9.2 Acknowledgement of inherent risks
The Guest acknowledges that spa and beauty services involve inherent risks, including but not limited to redness, irritation, allergic reactions, sensitivity, bruising, swelling, minor cuts, infection risk, lash shedding, nail breakage, uneven results, and individual reactions, which may occur even when Services are properly performed.

9.3 Waiver and limitation of liability
To the fullest extent permitted under Vietnamese law, the Guest agrees that the Supplier shall not be liable for outcomes resulting wholly or partly from:
• the Guest's failure to proactively inform the Supplier of their health condition in accordance with Article 6 of this Contract;
• the Guest's failure to follow pre-service or aftercare instructions;
• the Guest's own actions during or after the Services; and/or
• unforeseeable or unexpected events beyond the Supplier's reasonable control, including force majeure events.

9.4 Mandatory liability
Nothing in this Contract shall exclude or limit liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law.

9.5 Third-party damage
Where the Guest's breach or negligence causes damage to the Supplier, its staff, or third parties, the Guest shall compensate for such damage promptly and in full.

Payment, Invoicing & Taxes
10. Payment, invoicing, and taxes

10.1 The Guest shall settle all confirmed prices and applicable charges at checkout, unless otherwise agreed.

10.2 Where an invoice is requested, the Guest shall provide complete and accurate invoicing information.

10.3 The Supplier shall declare and pay applicable taxes in accordance with law.

Data Privacy & CCTV
11. Data, CCTV, and photos

11.1 CCTV may be used for safety and quality control purposes in accordance with applicable law and internal policy.

11.2 Photographs may be taken for quality control or after-sale support. Marketing use requires the Guest's consent.

Force Majeure
12. Force majeure

The Supplier shall not be liable for failure or delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, epidemics, power outages, or governmental restrictions. In such cases, the Supplier may reschedule or offer an alternative solution.

Amendments
13. Amendments

The Supplier may amend this Contract from time to time. Updated terms apply from the time of publication or notification and shall govern subsequent bookings and service engagements.

Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
14. Governing law and dispute resolution

14.1 This Contract is governed by the laws of Vietnam.

14.2 The Supplier does not participate in and shall not be responsible for any complaints, disputes, or claims, except where otherwise mandatorily required by the laws of Vietnam.

Severability & Non-Assignment
15. Severability and non-assignment

15.1 Invalid or unenforceable provisions shall not affect the validity of the remaining provisions.

15.2 The Guest may not assign rights or obligations under this Contract without the Supplier's prior written consent.

landing.privacyPolicyContent:
GROUP DATA PRIVACY POLICY

Welcome to The Privé Spa. This Data Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal information. By visiting our salon and spa or using our services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

1. Information We Collect:
   We may collect various types of information from you, including but not limited to:
   – Personal information (such as name, contact information, and birthdate)
   – Payment information (credit card details, billing address)
   – Health and medical information relevant to spa treatments
   – Communication preferences
   – Photographs including recordings & footages of the Guests before before, during and after the services

2. How We Use Your Information:
   We use the information we collect to:
   – Provide and manage our services, appointments, and treatments
   – Process payments and maintain financial records
   – Communicate with you about appointments, promotions, and updates
   – Customize your experience and tailor our services to your preferences
   – Comply with legal and regulatory requirements
   – Photographs including footage of Guests are used for training, quality control but also ensure the safety of our community. They are kept internally and stored temporarily inside our servers and are only used for marketing purposes with the (oral or written) consent of the Guests.

3. Data Sharing and Disclosure:
   We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with trusted third parties who assist us in operating our business, such as payment processors and marketing partners. We ensure that these third parties maintain the same level of data protection as outlined in this policy.

4. Security Measures:
   We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. Despite our efforts, no online data transmission or storage can be guaranteed as completely secure.

5. Your Choices:
   You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information held by us. You can also manage your communication preferences and opt out of promotional emails. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

6. Children’s Privacy:
   Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us to have the information removed.

7. Changes to this Policy:
   We reserve the right to modify this Data Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be effective upon posting in the salon. Your continued use of our services after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the modified policy.

8. Contact Us:
   If you have any questions or concerns about this Data Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at mgmt@theprivespa.com.

By visiting The Privé Spa salons and using our services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to this Data Privacy Policy.
Thank you for choosing The Privé Spa for your beauty and relaxation needs!
